title: Read drawing settings in sequence
description: You follow the canvas settings used by two rectangle calls.

steps.description: You import GraphicsWindow, create the window, and assign its title. canvas refers to the window's drawing surface.
You select a fill color before the first rectangle call. The call supplies its position and dimensions.

steps.question: Which settings change before the second rectangle is drawn?
steps.answer: The code sets a new fill and sets an outline color. Both calls appear before the second drawRectangle call.

steps.description: You draw the second rectangle and finish with win.wait(). The supplied recording contains no rendered drawing or text output.
